businesses.name: Rahman Electric LLC
businesses.what_they_do: Small electrical / low-voltage shop doing residential outlet and lighting repairs, TV wall mounting, home-theatre setup and security-camera work, plus a $39 on-site estimate and $40 dispatch fee. Its only web presence is a Square Appointments booking page (logo reads 'Rahman Electric', Google listing name is 'Rahman Services LLC').
businesses.customers: Homeowners in North Brunswick and nearby Middlesex County towns (inference from review text: bought-a-house electrical work, outlet replacement, TV mounting).

size_signals.signal: Google Business Profile shows 4.9 stars from 28 reviews and an 'Electrician' category - an established, actively reviewed shop
Published price list on its Square menu (estimate $39/30 min, dispatch fee $40, basic TV mount $150/45 min, deep-cleaning items $180-$450)
Owner replies to reviews ('Rahman and his team' thanked a reviewer), implying at least one helper on jobs

listing.platform: Google Business Profile (also on BuildZoom, blocked)

website_review.primary_cta: Book an appointment (Square service list with fixed prices)
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Yes - Square Appointments self-booking, no phone call needed
website_review.trust_signals: None on the booking page; the 4.9/28 reviews live only on Google
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Service menu mixes house-cleaning SKUs (post-renovation cleaning, 2-cleaner deep clean $450, move-in/out cleaning) with electrical and TV-mounting items, and 'MOVE IN/OUT 2 BEDS 2 BATHS' appears twice - looks like a reused or poorly set-up Square catalogue
website_review.search_basics: No own domain. Page title is 'Rahman Services | Book Appointments | N BRUNSWICK, NJ', which is reasonable, but book.squareup.com/robots.txt disallows /appointments/*/location/*/services/ so the service list and prices are not crawlable
top_issues: No business website at all - a third-party booking URL is the 'website' on Google
Service catalogue contains cleaning services the business does not appear to sell; a customer (or their agent) cannot tell what is actually offered
No phone number visible on the booking page and no click-to-call from a phone user landing there

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: claimed-looking GBP with hours (open until 5:30 PM), Electrician category, photos section and phone. Answerable: almost nothing crawlable - Square's robots.txt blocks the services URL, so hours/service area/prices exist only in the GBP; no LocalBusiness JSON-LD on the booking page. Bookable: genuine self-serve Square booking with fixed prices and no CAPTCHA, but the muddled menu makes an agent likely to book the wrong item, and there is no quote path for bigger electrical jobs.

operations_signals.signal: Sells a paid $39 on-site estimate as a separate bookable item - staff time goes into site visits that could be pre-qualified by an intake agent

Reviews mention responsiveness and outlets/lighting jobs, i.e. steady small-job call volume; owner replies appear only on older reviews (5 years, 3 years ago), suggesting ad-hoc not systematic review follow-up

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the Square-as-website with a small real site (services, service area, prices, licence, reviews) so the business is findable and answerable outside Google
top_opportunities.evidence: GBP website field points at a Square booking URL; robots.txt on book.squareup.com disallows the services page from crawling

top_opportunities.opportunity: Clean up and productise the Square service catalogue (electrical and low-voltage items only, clear names, no duplicated cleaning SKUs) so a booking is unambiguous
top_opportunities.evidence: Menu shows 'Post renovation cleaning $200', '2 cleaner 5 hour custom deep cleaning $450' and a duplicated move-in/out line alongside TV mounting

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated intake and quote follow-up: capture web/GBP enquiries, qualify the job, send the $39 estimate link, and chase no-replies
top_opportunities.evidence: $39 estimate plus $40 dispatch fee are manual, phone-driven steps; review replies are sporadic

scores.reasons: Gap 4: no site, blocked price page, confusing menu. Ability 3: 28 reviews, published ticket prices, but a tiny crew. Ease 4: a one-person consultancy can ship a 5-page site and a cleaned-up booking menu in days. Evidence 4: GBP and booking page both inspected directly; licence detail only seen in a blocked BuildZoom listing.

caveats: Six of the ten records (Home Handy Svc, Pro All Roofing, Miskolczi, Oscars, Rainbow, Faithful) could not be confirmed as trading; they appear only in low-quality aggregator directories, with no Google Business Profile and no website. Their top_opportunities are placeholders for 'verify first', not consulting work.

Google Maps was read through a browser session; where a business has no Google Business Profile the result list shows unrelated companies, which I treated as 'no listing'. 'Not found' means no listing found, not proof of closure.
Birdeye/Thumbtack/HomeAdvisor figures are third-party aggregator data; review counts there may lag behind or differ from Google.

Licence details for Rahman Electric (telecom licences 34TE00289500 / 34TC00289500, home-improvement licence 13VH11316100 cancelled) came from search-result summaries of a BuildZoom profile that returned 403 to both the fetch tool and a real browser; treat as unverified.
Ability-to-pay scores reflect inferred business size (owner-operator contractors), not financial data; no revenue, staff count or financial information was available for any business in this batch.
data_gaps: BuildZoom (rahman-electric-llc, pro-all-roofing-landscaping-llc-construction) and Yellow Pages returned Cloudflare 403 to both fetch_content and a real Chrome session; those profiles could not be inspected.
Angi (Home Handy Services Inc), HomeAdvisor (Franco Carpet) and unilocal returned 403; their review counts and hours are unconfirmed.
No phone number was available for Pro All Roofing; no reliable phone for Franco Carpet (batch record says unknown, Thumbtack hides it behind its lead form).
Could not open the Yellow Pages page that reportedly marks Rainbow Painting Contractors as closed, so the closed status is unverified.
hadaa.app's North Brunswick landscaper page and VerView's Rainbow page rendered no usable business content, so state-licence claims from those sources are unverified.
No businesses in this batch use an online booking platform other than Rahman (Square Appointments); none of the painters, the flooring installer or the handyman have any booking or quote automation.
